name: West Virginia
agency: West Virginia Department of Human Services (DoHS) local office

period.description: Your income and bills are counted over a six-month period of consideration; once you meet the spenddown, your card runs to the end of those six months.

submission.description: Bring or send your medical bills to your local DoHS office, whether or not you have paid them. Bring bills in even if you are not sure they count.

notes: Health insurance premiums, including Medicare, count toward the spenddown.
Any part of a bill paid by Medicare or other insurance does not count.
Coverage can go back up to three months before the month you applied.
